entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
..
 Versus  1. THE STATE OF BIHAR  2. NIDHI KUMARI WIFE OF SHAKTI NATH JHA RESIDENT OF  VILLAGE - KARAM, P.S. - PURAINI, DISTRICT - MADHEPURA,
 PRESENTLY RESIDING WITH HER FATHER SRI SURENDRA  MISHRA, RESIDENT OF VILLAGE - MURLICHANDWA, P.S. -
 UDAKISHUNGANJ, DISTRICT - MADHEPURA  ... ... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Barun Kumar Singh  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Sanjay Kumar  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SATYAVRAT VERMA  ORAL ORDER 2 15-04-2024 1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner seeks anticipatory bail in connection with Puraini P.S. Case No. 198 of 2023 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 341, 323, 379, 498A and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
It is further submitted that the investigation in the case is still pending.
3. The learned APP for the State submits that the offences for which the instant FIR has been instituted against the petitioner carries punishment of less than 7 years, the said Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.23741 of 2024(2) dt.15-04-2024 fact can be brought to the notice of the investigating authority, the said submission of the learned APP is not disputed by the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner.

4. In view of the submission made by the learned APP, the anticipatory bail application is disposed of in terms of the order dated 13-2-2024 passed in Criminal Miscellaneous No. 3536 of 2024 Shakti Nath Jha vs The State Of Bihar on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65974821/
1 (Naushad Ansari Vs. The State of Bihar).
